# R5.33 — Real permission wait, answer and resume matrix

**Spec:** `docs/tickets/203_R5.33__permission.md` (seq 203/246) · §5 of
`docs/evidence-and-adoption-spec.md` (s5 O1–O8 cells) ·
**Requirement ids:** none primary — contributing-only slice ·
**Landing record:** ADR-0411

## Summary

Lands the §5.2/D3-O4/O5 **real permission wait, answer and resume
matrix**. The monitor's respond authority is made honest over the
durable record (`crates/hh-monitor/src/approval.rs`, ADR-0411 — a
semantic tightening of the shared respond contract, the same class
as R5.24's R0 fold repair): `ApprovalState::fold` now folds the
durable `request.options[]` ids written since ADR-0343 D4 into
`ApprovalPending.request.options` (absent member folds empty —
pre-R2.11 rows stay ungated; an unparseable id drops, never
widens), and `respond_inner` gains the **offered-membership gate** —
when the folded offer is non-empty, a conferring/option-consuming
answer (`allow_once`, `allow_lease`, `modify`, `more_info`;
`remedy` against `request.remedies`) outside the durable offer
**restores the pending** and refuses typed
`ApprovalError::UnofferedOption{option_id}` — never decides, never
mints. `deny`/`cancelled` decide-against answers are exempt (a
refusal confers nothing; the wire's deny spellings predate the
closed id set). `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (read-only, ADR-0410
confinement unchanged) gains the O4/O5 evidence vocabulary — the
closed `PermissionFailure` set and the pure `o4_outcome`/
`o5_outcome` folds. `tests/r5_33.rs` runs the battery over the
**real** Store/WAL, Π `Monitor`, `Dispatcher` irreversible
`PermissionRequest` ask, `MarkerSink`/`OpsObserver`/`Sentinel`,
real `respond_with_ctx` + `decided` mint under the fenced writer,
`deliver_wakeup` (occurred→fired) and same-input re-dispatch (the
`decision_for_effect` resume leg): O4 allow — durable pending → two
clean no-mutation intervals → restart-preserved pending → offered
authority-checked `allow_once` → wakeup → resume on the same effect
with exactly one marker + matching digest, idempotent identical
re-answer, conflicting new-key refusal; O5 deny → refused resume
with zero mutation; unoffered/unauthorized answers refuse typed;
paused `input_required` is no permission wait. Recorded finding:
`service.rs:1967` hardcodes the four-option session scan —
contained by the fold-level gate, owned by a later ticket.
Predecessor contracts consumed unchanged; $0 spend; offline only.

## What changed

- `crates/hh-monitor/src/approval.rs` (+70/−1) — the offered-answer
  authority: `UnofferedOption` typed refusal, the `respond_inner`
  membership gate (before the legitimacy gate; pending restored on
  refusal), and the `request.options` fold.
- `crates/hh-monitor/src/approval/tests.rs` (+7) — the fixture
  request honestly offers `allow_lease` so the lease legs stay
  inside their own offer.
- `crates/hh-env/src/ops.rs` (+191) — `PermissionFailure` (closed
  14-member negative set), `PermissionOutcome`,
  `PermissionWaitCell`/`o4_outcome`, `PermissionDenyCell`/
  `o5_outcome`.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/r5_33.rs` (new, +1,157) — the permission
  battery: real Store/WAL + Monitor + Dispatcher rig, interval
  observer, restart leg, wakeup delivery, answer matrix.
- ADR-0411 + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md` /
  `REVISIT_TRIGGERS.md` (195 ADRs); ADR-0411 placed in BL-47's
  sources cell; dated coverage contributing note (seq 203) for the
  ten contributing REQs.

## Deviation (conspicuous)

**1,425 changed source/test lines vs the ≤600 trigger (~2.4×)** —
recorded Deviation, accepted per the scoped AMEND ruling
`fb67eeeb` (`docs/build/planning/2026-11-03_R5.33-split-review.md`):
the O2 partition packet binds env dispatcher + monitor responder +
apparatus case tests to one owner working set with no written
contingency (X7/E-207/F-005 carry verbatim contingencies; O2 none);
decomposition seq 203 is one owner row and the planning doc's four
weak seams are all consumed or other tickets' boundaries. The
monitor fold + `UnofferedOption` gate is an **existing-contract
repair inside this ticket's own deliverable** — the O4 cell's own
precondition (ADR-0343 D4 wrote durable `request.options` but the
fold dropped them; §5.2/D3-O4 "reject unoffered answer" is
definitional; the env `UnofferedAdmitted`/`UnauthorizedAdmitted`
cells cannot evidence without it). The proposed crate-seam cut is
the rejected impl-vs-battery split — leg (a) would land a semantic
tightening of the shared respond contract verified only by a
7-line fixture adjustment while its entire evidence matrix lives
in leg (b); AC-1/AC-2 span the cut, and leg (b) alone ~1,348 still
crosses the trigger (~81% of the bulk is the battery's required
real-Store/env/monitor/answer rig). Honest trip: review, not
redesign.

## AC → evidence

| AC | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 positive | met (engineered) | `o4_allow_wait_answer_resume_one_mutation` — real ask → `Suspended` → durable pending carrying the folded offered set; two clean no-mutation intervals; Store reopen → `pending_permissions` + `resumed{was_suspended}`; offered `allow_once` → `decided` → occurred→fired wakeup → same-input re-dispatch → exactly 1 marker + matching digest; identical re-answer `already_decided` (no second grant); conflicting new key refused |
| AC-2 negative | met (engineered) | `o5_deny_no_mutation_and_no_conflicting_grant` (offered deny → `decided{deny}` → refused resume; zero prepare/commit/entry/sink delta; conflicting later answer authorizes nothing); `unoffered_and_unauthorized_answers_refuse` (unoffered `allow_lease`/`modify`/`more_info`/`remedy` → `UnofferedOption`, pending restored; delegate/uncovered endorser → `IllegitimateEndorsement`; offered `more_info` → Ask, stays pending); `paused_input_required_is_no_permission_wait` (paused label leaves `committed` durable — no mediation) |
| AC-3 ownership/evidence | met | coverage register dated contributing note 2026-11-03 seq 203 — ten contributing REQs stamped contributing-only; achieved engineered D/E separate from owed R/P/actual-execution (R5.44 AC-1) |
| AC-4 scoped verification | met | commands/counts below; fails-without = compile-red at base `0550e6f5` (battery absent; fold dropped `request.options`, no gate); r5_33 4/4; fmt clean; scratch stores only |
